title: The Return of Raju
desc: A widow decides to seek the help of her husband's spirit when she sees the marital life of her son shattering in front of her.

title: Raksha Bandhan
desc: Embracing his role as the provider, Lala Kedarnath puts personal romantic interests on the back burner until his quirky sisters can be married off into loving families.

title: Pardes
desc: Kishorilal wants an Indian bride for his NRI son; he gets him engaged to Ganga, his friend's daughter. However, she seems to share a deeper bond with Arjun, Kishorilal's foster son.

title: Businessman 2
desc: A money-minded tycoon gets into a beneficial relationship with a woman. Soon, he learns about the differences in his family and decides to end them.

title: Raid 2
desc: An honest Income Tax officer, Amay Patnaik, confronts the corrupt nexus in Bhoj. Beneath the veneer of honesty lies a sinister operation tied to Dada Bhai, a revered politician.

title: Bhairavakona
desc: After committing a robbery, Basava and his companion, John, run into Agraharam Geetha, a stranger, and the trio end up in Bhairavakona, a village shrouded in mystery.

title: Kho Gaye Hum Kahan
desc: Three friends in their twenties, Imaad, Ahana, and Neil, try to figure out life in an ever-changing digital era. So, through love and heartbreak, they find support in each other.

title: Mrs. Chatterjee vs Norway
desc: Debika Chatterjee, an Indian woman living in Norway with her family, fights to regain custody of her children after Norwegian authorities take them away from her.

title: Boonie Bears: Back to Earth
desc: When Bramble merges with an alien artefact, he gains incredible abilities. With Avi by his side, he embarks on a high-stakes journey to defend their home from an intergalactic danger.

title: Parmanu: The Story of Pokhran
desc: A team of Indian government officials must manoeuvre a high-stakes nuclear test in a town in Rajasthan without being detected by reconnaissance satellites or espionage networks.

title: Enemy
desc: Rajiv grows envious of his childhood friend, Chozhan, as he is better than him at most things. The frenemies grow apart only to meet under very different circumstances several years later.

title: Holiday
desc: An army intelligence officer arrives in Mumbai to spend the holiday with his family. However, he must switch back to work mode after a bomb rips through the heart of the city.

title: The Greatest of All Time
desc: After a tragedy tears him apart from his wife, Gandhi, a former elite spy, is forced back into the field for a mission of the utmost importance.

title: Baadshah
desc: Raj, a small-time private detective who is desperate for a big break, gets drawn into a political conspiracy when he is hired to rescue a hostage.

title: Fukrey Returns
desc: Bholi Punjaban is back with a vengeance for round two of mischief, mayhem, and a get-rich-quick extravaganza with Hunny, Zafar, Lali, and deja choo expert Choocha.
